name: The Barrows
why: The Wall's south rim: the warcries, the grit wheel with maximum resistances on its other side, the fast two-hander, Cleaver by the Fosse, the middle road through Stone Ward, and Blood Rite, the biggest trade in the region.

clusters.name: War Drums
clusters.why: Warcries: duration and buff effect. Entered from the road down from Vampiric Strikes; passed through to the Barrows junction.

nodes.why: An entrance.

nodes.name: War Drums
nodes.why: Louder and longer: 2.5 + 1.3 units.
The exit to the junction.
The far side, where the leech chain arrives.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The fork between the grit wheel and the dear crossing from the Yard's bleed and leech.

clusters.name: Unbroken
clusters.why: The grit wheel: life at the entrance and the exit, a charge more on one side (Unbroken), a point of maximum resistance on the other (Tempered). Passed through, and neither side pays for the other.

nodes.name: Unbroken
nodes.why: A fourth grit charge: 3 units by the table and the node the whole area is for.
The resistance side.

nodes.name: Tempered
nodes.why: +1% to maximum resistances (2 units by the table, more in play), 1 unit of resistance and 1.3 of armour: 4.3. The armour is Elemental Ward's, which stop 3 (2026-10-22) sent to a farther cluster, placed in G3 round 2: armour with resistances on the far south-west grit wheel (20 steps from the Vanguard start, 21 from the Reaver's), not seven steps from the start; a strength build that comes here for it leaves the west tower's armour behind.
The resistance side, between Tempered and the entrance.

clusters.name: Heavy Hands
clusters.why: Two-handed attack speed three times, then the notable with speed and accuracy: the fast two-hander, far south beside the warcries and the grit (it was a side of the tower's wheel until 2026-10-20, a step from every other two-hander node). The approach to Blood Rite, whose own spur sells the life it asks for. The smalls are one unit each, 5% (7% until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22).

clusters.name: Blood Rite
clusters.why: Two nodes of life, then the trade: skills cost life, mana is 0, auras reserve life. The rim of the Wall. The keystone asks for a life pool, and the spur sells it.

clusters.name: The barrow road
clusters.why: Strength once, between the grit junction and Heavy Hands.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength three times: the road from the Barrows north to Vampiric Strikes, with the strength caster's pocket off its middle; its top node is a cross since G3 round 2 (Hammer Rhythm west, Stone Ward east, War Drums south).

clusters.name: The Barrows road
clusters.why: Eight attribute nodes from Heavy Hands east to the west side of the Yard's Pits: the Barrows had one way in, through War Drums, and the Wall and the Yard met only near home. Strength on the Wall half, strength and dexterity on the Yard half. The big axe leaves north from the third node, the regeneration pocket south from the fifth, Cleaver south from the sixth (G2, 2026-10-22).

clusters.name: Headsman
clusters.why: A pocket north off the Barrows road: two-handed damage twice, then the two-hander that stuns. On the Wall-Yard border, where a two-handed axe or sword finds both its strength and its dexterity.

nodes.name: Headsman
nodes.why: 1.7 + 1 + 1 units: the two-handed blow that lands like a mace.

clusters.name: Barrow Ward
clusters.why: A pocket south off the Barrows road: regeneration twice, then regeneration with less physical damage taken, for the Wall's and the Yard's slow, heavy builds. Since round 4 the Yard's Fosse road lands on the notable, so the pocket is a way between the Barrows and the Yard's south rim.

nodes.name: Barrow Ward
nodes.why: 2 + 2 units.

clusters.name: Iron Liturgy
clusters.why: A pocket west off the middle of the road north from the Barrows: spell damage twice, then spells with armour, the strength caster. The Wall sold no spells.

clusters.name: The tower road
clusters.why: Three strength nodes from the Greatweight wheel down to Iron Liturgy: the west towers and the Barrows were joined only through the middle. Long Watch (the totems) leaves south from its last node since G3 round 2.

clusters.name: The barrow stair
clusters.why: Four strength nodes from Iron Liturgy down to the grit wheel: a second way into the Barrows on their west side. Long Reach leaves west from the second node, and Hammer Rhythm arrives there from the east (G3 round 2).

clusters.name: Long Reach
clusters.why: A chain west off the barrow stair: melee area twice, then reach and area, for the slam and the sweep. A bridge since G3 round 2: Long Watch lands on its first small from the north.

nodes.name: Long Reach
nodes.why: 2 + 1.25 units.

clusters.name: Greatblade
clusters.why: A pocket south off the Barrows road, where it turns hybrid toward the Yard: two-handed damage twice, then the two-handed sword. The smalls were sword damage until G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22): the sword-and-shield build bought the whole pocket as more sword and the two-handed half never mattered; now a one-handed sword pays two two-handed smalls for the notable's sword, and the two-handed sword finds its home. The Yard had no home for it; this one sits on the Wall-Yard road, where its strength and dexterity are both supplied. It hung off the second road node, beside Headsman and Heavy Hands, until round 4 (2026-10-20), which made the three two-hander notables a row on adjacent road nodes.

clusters.name: Cleaver
clusters.why: Axe damage twice, then axe damage with axe speed: a chain south off the Barrows road where it turns strength-and-dexterity, facing the Yard's Fosse, so an axe build finds both its attributes on the way (G2, 2026-10-22; it was in the Barbican's west, the side farthest from any dexterity). The Yard's Hewing is the other axe, about ten steps east.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the Barrows road.

nodes.name: Cleaver
nodes.why: Axe damage and axe speed: 2 + 2 units.
The far small, facing the Yard's Fosse road.

clusters.name: The Barrows' middle road
clusters.why: Strength twice on a line across Stone Ward's chain (G2, 2026-10-22): north to Second Wind, south down Iron Voice's warcry smalls to the Barrows road. Before it, the only ways between the Quarry and the Barrows road went round by War Drums or the Pits. Since G3 round 2 it crosses Stone Ward at a small and passes Iron Voice beside its notable, so the road buys no notable it does not want.

clusters.name: Iron Voice
clusters.why: Warcry buff effect four times on the Barrows' middle road, with the notable of armour and warcry buff effect in a triangle off its middle: the shouting Vanguard in plate, for the warcry and totem build (G3, 2026-10-22; the ledger's VA-3). The smalls were armour until G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22): a cluster whose smalls are the generic stat is taken by every build that wants armour, and Iron Voice was in six of the seven armour builds' plans, so the strength builds' armour at 120 points rose by half over G0; the smalls now carry the partner, the armour stays on the notable, and a build passing south pays warcry smalls as road. The smalls lie on the straight line from Stone Ward's road node down to the Barrows road, so the road is whole and the Quarry reaches the Barrows through the middle; the notable is a step off it (G3 round 2: it sat in the line, a toll on the road). The strength defence's south-west direction, far from both strength starts; War Drums (warcry duration and effect) is the warcry twin, seven steps west by the junction.

nodes.why: The north end, from the middle road.

nodes.name: Iron Voice
nodes.why: 2 + 2 units: 4. Armour and the warcry in even measure (the round-1 allocator showed the strength builds' armour doubling at 120 points with a heavier armour line). The triangle's apex, east of the road.
The south end, toward the Barrows road.

clusters.name: Hammer Rhythm
clusters.why: Mace attack speed three times round the notable with mace damage and mace attack speed: the fast mace, a square bridging the Barrows' north road and the barrow stair (G3 round 2, 2026-10-22; the ledger's VA-4). Entered from the east and the west, the notable the south corner, so the way across takes a small and the notable is a step's detour. The Vanguard's other plain maces sell the stun (Weight of Iron, the tower), life (Sledge and Sinew, the Quarry floor), crit (Crushing Blow) and elemental damage (Hallowed Hammer); this one, south-west and far, sells speed, which the Vanguard otherwise sends its maces to the Strider for.

nodes.why: The east corner, the door from the north road.
The west corner, the door from the barrow stair.

nodes.name: Hammer Rhythm
nodes.why: 2 + 1.6 units: 3.6. The south corner.

clusters.name: Long Watch
clusters.why: Totem speed three times round the notable with totem speed and totem duration: totems that are set down quickly and stand long, a diamond bridging the west road (by Iron Liturgy) and Long Reach's chain (G3 round 2, 2026-10-22; the ledger's VA-7). The warcry and totem build's far totem: Standing Cairns (totem damage with area) is ten steps from the start by the Quarry, this one about eighteen by the west, and the Strider's Sentry Post and the Cathedral's Reliquary sell totems with bows and with spells. Long Reach stops being a dead end.

nodes.why: The north corner, the door from the west road.
The south corner, the door from Long Reach's chain.

nodes.name: Long Watch
nodes.why: 2.3 + 1.3 units: 3.6. The west corner. A small is 4% (1.1 units): totem speed is priced at 3.5% a unit.

clusters.name: Bellows
clusters.why: Fire damage with attacks three times on a straight chain south from the Barrows road to Grave Host's chain, with the notable of fire attacks and melee area in a triangle off it: the swing that throws a sheet of fire, below the Barrows road in its empty south (G3 round 3, 2026-10-22; added beyond the brief because the two-handed fire build held the strength side's only fire-attack cluster, Hot Iron, by 60 points and its fire attacks were flat after 120: out of supply). The second fire-attack direction: Hot Iron (fire with stun) is on the far west rim beside the Cathedral's burning (Censer, Brazier, Searing Avatar), this one is south, a build that wants both crosses the region; the Cathedral's Kindled Steel sells fire attacks with ignite. Six steps from Headsman by the road, so the two-hander's stun and this are not one stop. Grave Host stops being a dead end.

nodes.why: The north end, from the Barrows road.

nodes.name: Bellows
nodes.why: 2 + 2 units: 4. Fire with the swing's reach, for the slam and the cleave alike (Hot Iron's partner is stun, Kindled Steel's ignite, Elemental Edge's accuracy). The triangle's apex, south-east of the chain.
The south end, toward Grave Host's chain.

clusters.name: Grave Host
clusters.why: A pocket south off the Barrows road: minion life twice, then minion life with the summoner's armour. The strength summoner's cluster and every summoner's farthest: the other minion notables are in the Cathedral (Shepherd, Ossuary), on the Spire's Cathedral side (Familiars) and on the Knife's Docks wheel (Black Flock). Round 3 (2026-10-20). Since G3 round 3 (2026-10-22) Bellows' chain lands on its second small, so the pocket is a loop with the Barrows road, no longer a dead end.

nodes.name: Grave Host
nodes.why: 2 + 1.7 units: Shepherd sells minion life with damage and speed; this sells it with the summoner's own armour.

clusters.name: Stone Ward
clusters.why: A chain east off the Barrows' north road, under War Drums: spell block twice, then spell block with life on block. Spell block for any build, shield or none, on the strength side: the tree's other two are shield-only and on the intelligence side (Spirit Ward in the Spire, Glass Wall in the Crypt). Round 4 (2026-10-20). The Barrows' middle road crosses it at its second small, so the chain is a bridge and the notable a step's detour off the road (G3 round 2, 2026-10-22: since G2 the road ran through the notable, so anyone going south by the middle bought a spell block notable).

nodes.why: Where the middle road crosses: on the straight line between the road's two nodes.

nodes.name: Stone Ward
nodes.why: 2 + 2 units. The tip, east of the road.

clusters.name: Two Fists
clusters.why: A pocket west off the Barrows' west road, between Greatweight and Long Reach: dual-wield damage twice, then dual wield with armour. The strength side's dual wield, for two axes or two maces; the Yard's Twin Fangs sells it with speed and block, Crossed Blades with crit. Round 4 (2026-10-20).

nodes.name: Two Fists
nodes.why: 2 + 1.7 units.

links.why: The north road onto spell block.
The west road onto the strength dual wield.
The Barrows road onto the minion pocket.
The Barrows road's third node south onto Bellows (Headsman leaves it north): the node is a cross.
Bellows on to Grave Host's second small, in the chain's own line: the fire and the minions are a loop with the Barrows road, and neither is a dead end.
The Barrows road onto the two-handed sword.
The Barrows road onto the axe, south toward the Fosse.

Axes by the Fosse (a near crossing; G1-brief.md §2.4, laid in the G2 border pass): Cleaver's far small onto the Yard's outer road, in the chain's own line, so Cleaver is a bridge between the Barrows road and the Fosse. The Reaver's axe and bleed build reaches Cleaver by the rim (Hewing to Cleaver about 10 steps), and the Vanguard reaches the Fosse's lightning and curses. Far from both starts (22 from the Vanguard, 17 from the Reaver).
Second Wind onto the Barrows' middle road.
The middle road crosses Stone Ward's chain at its second small: the chain is a bridge and the notable a detour, not a toll (G3 round 2).
And on south, toward the Barrows road.
The middle road onto Iron Voice, straight on.
Iron Voice onto the Barrows road: the middle road is whole, Second Wind to the Barrows' second road node.
The Greatweight wheel onto the tower road.
The tower road lands on Iron Liturgy, which is now a crossroads.
Iron Liturgy onto the barrow stair.
The barrow stair lands on the grit wheel's entrance.
The barrow stair onto the long reach.
The north road west onto Hammer Rhythm: north.a is a cross now (the road north, War Drums south, Stone Ward east, the fast mace west).
Hammer Rhythm onto the barrow stair, straight on to Long Reach: a second way between the north road and the stair besides Iron Liturgy.
The west road, where it meets Iron Liturgy, south onto Long Watch.
Long Watch onto Long Reach's chain: the totems bridge the west road and the stair, and Long Reach has two doors.
Heavy Hands onto the Barrows road.
The Barrows road lands on the west junction of the Pits.
The road onto the big axe.
The road onto the regeneration pocket.
The road north onto the strength caster.
Through the drums to the junction.
Junction to the grit wheel.
The wheel's far side leads to endurance.
Heavy Hands to the keystone spur.
Strength once, between the grit junction and Heavy Hands.
The far end of the road.

name: The Gate
why: Two stat nodes off the start (armour north, melee damage south), the signature between them, two hubs one step out with a pocket each, and three roads: the rampart highway north-west, the tower road (life) west, the slam highway south.

clusters.name: Oathbound
clusters.why: The loop the start opens onto: armour on the north side, melee physical damage on the south, the signature at the tip. Point one is a side; point two is the signature, a hub, or a road.

nodes.why: The north side: defence.

nodes.name: Oathbound
nodes.why: The signature: life, the weapon's damage and strength. 3.9 units, at step two or three. The tower road leaves from here.
The south side: offence.

clusters.name: The hubs
clusters.why: Strength, one step past each side node: the north hub joins the ring toward the Zealot and starts the rampart road; the south hub joins the ring toward the Reaver and starts the slam road.

clusters.name: Ringing Blows
clusters.why: The north hub's pocket, a straight chain: melee damage twice and a notable with melee damage and the blow that rocks them (lower enemy stun threshold): the Vanguard's first offence on the north side, for any melee weapon, named for none, two to four points out. It was Unshakable (stun threshold, stun recovery) until G3 round 2 (2026-10-22): within six steps of the start every notable but Oathbound and the Banner was defence or utility, and the north side ran stun threshold, resistances, mana and armour before any offence (CONSTRAINTS §4.8). Stun threshold is still sold by Ox Hide (with armour, the far west), and as lines on Bracing and Unhurried (Stone Heart sold it with life until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22, and became Weak Spot, melee crit). Its chain leaves the north hub about 36° from the rampart road and from the Banner's link, an even fan (G4 fix 1: it left 21° from the Banner's, a sliver).

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the hub.

nodes.name: Ringing Blows
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units: harder blows, and stuns that come sooner. The stun clusters farther out sell it with a weapon (Weight of Iron, the mace; Headsman, the two-hander) or with duration (Stagger, Hot Iron).

clusters.name: Quartermaster
clusters.why: The south hub's pocket, a straight chain: two flask recovery nodes and a notable with flask effect and recovery. The early game is life flasks; this is the cheap way to make them matter, for any class that crosses here. Swung west into the hub's empty side in G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22): it hung south between the hub and the slam road, and the pocket, the road and the rung between them were a ladder of slivers (near-misses of 25° to 28° at the hub, the notable and Thunderstep). Now the rung to the slam road runs nearly level and the link to Thunderstep straight down.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the hub.

clusters.name: The rampart road
clusters.why: Strength twice: the highway from the north hub to the rampart's wheel.

clusters.name: The tower road
clusters.why: Life three times: the road west from the signature toward the maces (it was melee physical damage until 2026-10-20, which committed the first points).

clusters.name: Shield Ram
clusters.why: Attack damage with a shield three times round the notable with shield attack damage and stun duration: the shield used as a weapon, a diamond pocket off the rampart road's second node, in the room between the rampart road and the tower road (G3 round 3, 2026-10-22; the ledger's VA-8). An optional porch for the shield Vanguard, five or six points out: Bracing (block with a shield) leaves the start south-east, this leaves it north-west, so the shield's offence and its block are two directions. Its twin is the Yard's Shield Bash (shield attacks with shield speed and life on block), far east in the Muster. A pocket, not the bridge the brief drew: as a bridge to the tower road its three smalls let a build on the tower road join the rampart highway without the north hub, a stat connector standing in for the highway beside the start (CONSTRAINTS §7.1), and the allocator found one mace-and-shield plan far ahead of every other at 120 points. A shield is not a weapon, so nothing within three steps of the start names one (§6.3). Ringing Blows, round the north hub, lowers the enemy's stun threshold for any melee weapon; this lengthens the stun for a shield: a build that wants both stuns may take both (§8.3).

nodes.why: The north corner, the entrance from the rampart road.

nodes.name: Shield Ram
nodes.why: 2 + 1.7 units: 3.7. The rim of the shield brought down: harder blows with it, and the stun they leave lasts longer. The west corner, a step from the entrance either way round.

clusters.name: The slam road
clusters.why: Strength twice: the highway from the south hub to Thunderstep.

clusters.name: To the ring
clusters.why: One attribute node between the hub and the centre ring: the highway home, and a step further to the first other attribute.

links.why: Point one, the north side.
Point one, the south side.
The north side to the north hub.
The south side to the south hub.
The north hub's pocket.
The south hub's pocket.
The north hub joins the ring one node toward the Zealot, clear of the start.
One attribute node between the hub and the centre ring: the highway home, and a step further to the first other attribute.
The far end of the road.
The rampart road.
The tower road.
The slam road.
The reservation chain north, toward the Zealot.
Strength once between the rampart highway and the Bulwark wheel.
The far end of the road.
Strength twice between the tower road and Weight of Iron.
The far end of the road.
The slam road reaches the slams.
The rampart road's second node south onto Shield Ram's entrance: the shield pocket.
The melee pocket is also a way onto the rampart road: a pocket as a bridge.
The flask pocket is also a way onto the slam road.
And straight on to the slams: the pocket is a loop with the slam road.
The melee pocket to the Banner chain: a loop with the north hub.

name: The Barbican
why: The Wall's west tower: a mace cluster for the stun, another for the crit, the two-hander wheel (damage or life), Rooted Stance at the tip, and the west rim road with Grim Oath and Ox Hide. Not every weapon's only home: two-handers are also at the slams and in the far south, the second mace is the Cathedral's sceptre wheel, the third Hallowed Hammer by the rampart.

clusters.name: Weight of Iron
clusters.why: Maces first, because the kit is one. Mace lines also reach sceptres, so a Zealot who crosses here is served too. Passed through to the junction.

nodes.name: Weight of Iron
nodes.why: Mace damage with the stun a mace is for: 1.7 + 1.3 + 1 units.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The fork between the deep west and the two-hander wheel; the road from Mortar and Stone arrives here from the rampart.

clusters.name: Crushing Blow
clusters.why: Melee crit twice around the notable with mace crit, mace crit multiplier and double damage: the crit mace's cluster, at the foot of the road north to Battle Hymn. The other mace cluster (Weight of Iron, by the tower road) sells the stun; a mace build picks the crit here or the stun there.

clusters.name: Greatweight
clusters.why: The tower's landmark: a wheel of six with two notables, two-handed damage on one side, life on the other, so the two-hander picks the bigger hit or the bigger body. The blow's stun rides on the hit side (stun duration, one unit) and the body's on the life side (less stun taken), in place of the strength both carried until G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22): strength is worth nothing to a build's wishes, so each read as a notable of two and a half units. Stun is led by Weight of Iron (with a mace) and Headsman (with a two-hander, 19 steps south); Greatweight was stun-led until round 4 and carries it only as a partner now. Two-handed speed is far south (Heavy Hands, by the grit) and the slam with a two-hander is Thunderstep: three places, three partners. Passed through toward the keystone.

nodes.name: Greatweight
nodes.why: 2.5 units of two-handed damage and 1 of stun duration: 3.5. The heaviest blow leaves them reeling longer (G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22: it carried 16 strength, which no build weighs).
The life side.

nodes.name: Broad Back
nodes.why: 2.4 + 1 units: 3.4. The body that carries the weapon, life and a shorter stun when something does knock it down (G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22: it carried 16 strength, which no build weighs). Its armour went in G3 round 2 (2026-10-22): life with armour 13 steps from the start was the far hybrid every strength build took at 60 points, beside Mortar and Stone, Locked Shields and Ox Hide (the west tower's armour hot spot). Second Wind sells life with regeneration, the Reaver's Scarred Hide life with stun threshold.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The fork at the tower's tip: the keystone spur or Ox Hide and the west rim road.

clusters.name: Rooted Stance
clusters.why: Two nodes about not being moved, then the trade: cannot be stunned, cannot evade. The far keystone of the tower.

clusters.name: Ox Hide
clusters.why: Armour twice, then the notable with armour and stun threshold: the Vanguard who wants to stand in the hit, on the west rim beside Rooted Stance. The keystone makes stun threshold moot, so the two are a fork at the tower's tip. A pocket two steps off the tower road until G2 (2026-10-22), when the Wall's strength defence was one corner by the home; the road's pocket is Weak Spot's now (melee crit; Stone Heart until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22).

nodes.why: The entrance, from the Rooted Stance junction.

nodes.name: Ox Hide
nodes.why: Armour and twice the stun threshold of a small: 3.7 units. The west rim road goes on north from it.

clusters.name: The west rim road
clusters.why: Strength along the west rim, from Grim Oath south to Ox Hide and the Rooted Stance junction (G2, 2026-10-22): Grim Oath stops being a dead end and the Barbican's west tip is a loop with the road to Battle Hymn. Hot Iron sits between the two nodes (G3).

clusters.name: Hot Iron
clusters.why: Fire damage with attacks three times beside the notable with fire attacks and stun duration: the heavy burning blow that staggers, for the two-handed fire build (G3, 2026-10-22; the ledger's VA-6). On the west rim road between Grim Oath and Ox Hide, in Hallowed Hammer's old place, with a third small toward the road to Battle Hymn: the far west's fire, where the Cathedral's burning (Censer, Searing Avatar) comes in by the rim. Stun's other homes sell it with a mace (Weight of Iron), a two-hander (Headsman) and any weapon (Stagger); this one sells it with fire. Since G3 round 2 the rim road and the door from the tower pass by the two north smalls and the notable sits a step outside them, on the rim (the notable sat in the road's line, so the rim road and the tower's door both bought it).

nodes.why: North, on the rim road from Grim Oath; the door from the tower lands here.

nodes.name: Hot Iron
nodes.why: 2 + 1.7 units: 3.7. The triangle's apex, outside the rim road.
South, on the rim road to Ox Hide.
East, toward the road to Battle Hymn.

clusters.name: The tower road
clusters.why: Strength once, between the tower junction and the Greatweight wheel.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength twice between the tower road and Weight of Iron.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between Crushing Blow and Stagger.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once off the tower junction toward the deep west, where Cleaver stood until G2 (2026-10-22): Locked Shields took its square in G3 and joins here, with Steady Hands and Crushing Blow. Moved in G3 onto the straight line from the junction to the pentagon's east corner (its id is kept from Cleaver's time).

clusters.name: Locked Shields
clusters.why: The shield's own defences four times round the notable with armour and block with a shield: the shield wall's armour, deep west between the Rampart and the Barbican (G3, 2026-10-22; the ledger's VA-2, with the armour section VA-s1 folded in). The smalls were plain armour until G3 round 2: the two-handed builds took the pentagon at 60 points for its armour smalls alone, the fourth armour cluster of the west tower; defences from a shield keep it the shield wall's and nobody else's. A regular pentagon in Cleaver's old square, three corners facing the three roads that reach it (Steady Hands north-east, the tower junction east, Crushing Blow west); the notable is the far corner, so the way across takes smalls and the notable is a step's detour. For one-handers with a shield, mace or sword: Bracing (block with block recovery) leaves the start south-east, this is the far one. The strength defence's west direction: Mortar and Stone is north-east by the road to the tower, Ox Hide on the west rim, Iron Voice in the Barrows.

nodes.why: The north-east corner, the door from Steady Hands.
The east corner, the door from the tower junction.

nodes.name: Locked Shields
nodes.why: 2 + 2.5 units: 4.5. Armour and block with a shield in even measure (the round-1 allocator showed the strength builds' armour doubling at 120 points with a heavier armour line); the far corner.
The west corner, the door from Crushing Blow.

clusters.name: To Ground Shaker
clusters.why: One strength node from the tower junction down to Ground Shaker, so the slams and the Barrows are not all behind one junction.

clusters.name: To Battle Hymn
clusters.why: Four attribute nodes from Crushing Blow north to Battle Hymn: the Barbican and the Cathedral's outer side meet. Hallowed Hammer left the second node in G2 (2026-10-22) for the rampart's junction; Hot Iron, on the west rim, joins it there since G3. G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22): the road leaves Crushing Blow's small west of north and runs straight to its last node (it left 22° from the road to Stagger, a near-miss at a small that is also a junction, and bent at its first node); positions only, no shortcut between Stagger and the road.

clusters.name: Grim Oath
clusters.why: A pocket west off the road to Battle Hymn: curse effect twice, then curse effect with cast speed (with armour until G3 round 2). The strength curser's cluster, for the warlord's curses and a curse on hit; the other three sell curses with area and duration (Hexwright, in the Spire), a second curse (Second Curse, in the Knife) and damage against the cursed (Marked Prey, on the Yard's Fosse). Round 4 (2026-10-20). The head of the west rim road since G2 (2026-10-22).

nodes.name: Grim Oath
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units: the curse laid stronger and sooner (a curse is a spell). Its armour went in G3 round 2 (2026-10-22): the two-handed fire build bought it for the armour beside Hot Iron and Ox Hide, the west tower's armour hot spot. The other curse clusters sell area and duration (Hexwright), a second curse (Second Curse) and damage against the cursed (Marked Prey).

links.why: The road to Battle Hymn onto the strength curse.
Four attribute nodes from Crushing Blow north to Battle Hymn: the Barbican and the Cathedral's outer side meet.
The far end of the road.
The tower junction onto the road to Ground Shaker.
The road lands on Ground Shaker.
Through the maces to the first junction.
Strength once off the tower junction toward the deep west.
The road from the tower junction onto Locked Shields, straight on.
Steady Hands' far small, which faced the deep west, onto Locked Shields: the accuracy pocket and the shield wall are a loop with the junction.
Crushing Blow onto Locked Shields from the west: the crit mace and the shield wall meet, and the Battle Hymn road reaches the deep west without the tower junction.
Strength once, between the tower junction and the Greatweight wheel.
The far end of the road.
Strength once between the Greatweight wheel and the Rooted Stance junction.
Junction to the keystone spur.
Junction to Ox Hide: the keystone that cannot be stunned, or the armour with stun threshold beside it.
Ox Hide onto the west rim road, north.
The west rim road, south from Grim Oath, onto Hot Iron.
And on south toward Ox Hide: the rim road is whole.

Hot Iron's third door, east onto the road to Battle Hymn (where Hallowed Hammer hung until G2): the fire is reached from the tower without walking the rim. It lands on the north small (G3 round 2), so the door does not buy the notable.
Grim Oath onto the west rim road, south: the curse pocket stops being a dead end.

name: The Rampart
why: The Wall's north-west, under the battlements: the Bulwark wheel (armour or mana on hit), Weak Spot (melee crit) off the tower road, the accuracy pocket, Stagger and Unerring Discipline.

clusters.name: The Bulwark
clusters.why: The rampart's landmark: a wheel of eight off the rampart road, armour (Mortar and Stone) on the south-west side and mana on hit (Iron Lungs, its own cluster) on the north-west. Entered from the rampart road on the east; the way on to the junction runs through Iron Lungs, so the armour is the detour (G2, 2026-10-22: it was life one side and armour the other, a choice every strength build took both sides of).

nodes.why: The entrance: a strength road node where the rampart road meets the wheel and forks to its two sides (G3, 2026-10-22; a life small until then, the last of the wheel's old life side, which left the armour side's section mixed).

nodes.name: Mortar and Stone
nodes.why: The armour notable: a flat 2% physical reduction on top, which armour alone never gives against a big hit. 4.5 units. The road to the tower leaves from it.

clusters.name: Iron Lungs
clusters.why: Mana on hit with melee attacks either side of the notable with mana on hit, mana leech and mana: the melee Vanguard who runs dry by map five. The Bulwark's north-west side since G2 (2026-10-22), on the way from the rampart road to the junction, so the wheel asks for sustain on the way or armour as the detour (it was a pocket off the armour notable until then).

nodes.why: The wheel's north small: the rampart road's second door.

nodes.name: Iron Lungs
nodes.why: 2 + 1 + 1 units. The way out to the junction.
Between Iron Lungs and the armour side.

clusters.name: Weak Spot
clusters.why: Melee crit chance twice, then the notable with melee physical damage and melee crit chance: the blow that finds the gap in the plate, for any melee weapon, a pocket off the tower road eight points from the start (G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22; the id is Stone Heart's, which sold life with stun threshold here). The home's west was life three times on the road and life again in this pocket, the Vanguard's steps 5 to 8 the least offence of any start (CONSTRAINTS §4.8), and the Vanguard sold almost no crit (§4.6); Scarred Hide, the Reaver's, kept the same pairing as Stone Heart (§5.1). Crit's other Wall homes have other partners: Crushing Blow sells it with a mace and the multiplier, Unbloodied on full life. Not the crit multiplier: that is the Reaver–Strider seam's partner. A straight chain from its road node, on the line the branch leaves the tower road by.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the road.

nodes.name: Weak Spot
nodes.why: Melee physical damage with melee crit chance: 2 + 1.5 units, 3.5. The tip, a dead end off the life road.

clusters.name: Stagger
clusters.why: Stun duration, then the notable with duration, the enemy's stun threshold and stun damage: stun at the tower's top, off the accuracy pocket's far side, its first node also the bridge to the crit chain. The other stun is on the weapons (Weight of Iron, Greatweight); this one is for any weapon.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the accuracy pocket; also the bridge to the crit chain, and since G3 round 3 the landing of Graven Posts (the totems) from Hallowed Hammer.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The rampart's junction, off Iron Lungs: the keystone spur west, the accuracy pocket south-west, the resist star's fire spoke east, Hallowed Hammer north.

clusters.name: Unerring Discipline
clusters.why: The spur to the first keystone: two nodes about hitting, then the trade (attacks always hit; never a critical strike). Dead-ended, off the junction, as the reference places its keystones. Turned west in G2 (2026-10-22), so the keystone stands about 320 units from the Zealot's Idle Hands instead of 130; lowered a little in G3 round 3 (about 360 from Idle Hands), so the new totem chain from Hallowed Hammer to Stagger passes clear above it.

clusters.name: Steady Hands
clusters.why: Accuracy is a melee Vanguard's problem (strength gives none); this is the cheap answer beside the keystone that is the permanent one. Entered from the junction, left by the road to Stagger; its far small faces the Barbican's deep west.

nodes.why: The entrance from the junction.

nodes.name: Steady Hands
nodes.why: 2 units of accuracy and 1.6 of speed: 3.6.
The far side, facing the deep west.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between the rampart highway and the Bulwark wheel.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between the rampart junction and the resist star.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between Steady Hands and Stagger.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once off the rampart highway, where the resist star's chaos spoke and the Bulwark's north small land: the wheel's second door and the star's landing (it led to Second Wind until G2, 2026-10-22).

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between the rampart junction and Steady Hands.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between the tower road and Weak Spot (the pocket was Ox Hide until G2, Stone Heart until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22). It leaves the road about 40° off its line (G4 fix 1: it left 20° off, so it read as a fork in the road rather than a branch), and the pocket runs straight on from it.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength twice from Mortar and Stone straight to the tower's first junction, where Iron Lungs' pocket ran until G2 (2026-10-22): the rampart and the Barbican stay joined a second time.

links.why: Strength once between the tower road and Weak Spot.
The far end of the road: Weak Spot, straight on.
The wheel's entrance onto the sustain side.
The sustain side meets the armour side.
Out of the wheel through Iron Lungs to the junction: the armour is the detour.
The wheel's north small onto the rampart road's second node: a second door.
The far end of the road.
Mortar and Stone onto the road to the tower.
The road lands on the tower's first junction.
Strength once between Steady Hands and Stagger.
The far end of the road.
Strength once between Crushing Blow and Stagger.
The far end of the road.
Junction to the keystone spur.
Strength once between the rampart junction and Steady Hands.
The far end of the road.

name: The Battlements
why: The Wall's north, on the Cathedral border: the resist star as the connector, the Warlord's Banner chain toward the Zealot, Scar Tissue at the tip where the Cathedral's fire two-hander arrives, and Hallowed Hammer on the west, where maces meet the Cathedral's sceptres.

clusters.name: Elemental Ward
clusters.why: The resist star: all resistances in the notable, one single-node spoke per element, each landing somewhere else. Fire south-west to the rampart's junction, chaos south-east to the rampart road, cold west to Scar Tissue, lightning north to the crossing junction.

nodes.name: Elemental Ward
nodes.why: 2.5 units of resistance and 1 of life.
The fire spoke, to the rampart's junction.
The chaos spoke, to the rampart road.
The cold spoke, to Scar Tissue.
The lightning spoke, to the crossing junction.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The crossing junction: the near crossing to the Cathedral's block and shields (north), Scar Tissue west, the star south, the Banner chain east.

clusters.name: Scar Tissue
clusters.why: Grit when hit, then the notable with grit when hit and regeneration per charge: the build that is hit a lot and shrugs, at the end of a short chain beside the dear crossing from the Cathedral's fire tower. The grit wheel is far south (Unbroken); a grit build takes this one with the armour and the resistances, or that one with the warcries.

nodes.name: Scar Tissue
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units.

clusters.name: Hallowed Hammer
clusters.why: Mace damage twice, then maces with elemental damage, and one more mace small facing the Cathedral: a pocket bridge north off the rampart's junction toward the Zealot's sceptre road, so maces and sceptres meet (G2, 2026-10-22; it was a dead end off the road to Battle Hymn, at the far west). The third mace cluster, with Weight of Iron (stun) and Crushing Blow (crit).

nodes.why: The entrance, from the rampart's junction.

nodes.name: Hallowed Hammer
nodes.why: 1.4 + 2 units. Its smalls are one unit each, 14% (12% until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22).
The far small, facing the Cathedral's sceptre road.

clusters.name: Graven Posts
clusters.why: Totem damage twice, then the notable with totem damage and all resistances: a chain west off Hallowed Hammer's middle small, under the battlements, that goes on to Stagger at the tower's top (G3 round 3, 2026-10-22; added beyond the brief because the warcry and totem build held both Vanguard totem clusters by 120 points: the specialization ran out of supply, not of reach). The third direction for the Vanguard's totems: Standing Cairns (damage with area) is south-east by the Quarry, Long Watch (speed and duration) west-south-west by Iron Liturgy, and this is north-west, on the side of the Cathedral's totem keystone across the border, so a totem build that comes here leaves the Barrows' warcries behind. The way from the home passes Iron Lungs or Elemental Ward, notables of other kinds. The partner is the totem player's ward, standing back while the posts fight. Since G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22) the notable also leads east to the Zealot's Twofold Guard (`cathedral.rods.guard.b`, seam 5: block and spell block with a shield), the cross-border end of the chain.

nodes.why: The entrance, from Hallowed Hammer's middle small.

nodes.name: Graven Posts
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units: 3.5. On the straight line from Hallowed Hammer's small to Stagger's, so the chain is a bridge between the mace chain and the tower's top.

clusters.name: Warlord's Banner
clusters.why: Reduced mana reservation twice, then the notable with reservation, aura effect and mana: the Vanguard's standards, as a chain from the north hub toward the Zealot, its two smalls beside the notable on the line toward the hub (G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22: they were strung 180 apart along the seam and read as a road). The Wall's only reservation lines, and the Cathedral's way in. Its armour went in G3 (2026-10-22): a notable three steps from the Zealot start and five from the Vanguard's sold reservation, armour and mana, three themes, and armour this near two starts is strength by the back door.

nodes.name: Warlord's Banner
nodes.why: 1.7 + 1.3 + 1.5 units: what an aura carrier wants from a banner, reserving less and the aura stronger.

links.why: The chaos spoke lands on the rampart road's node, straight on from the star (G2, 2026-10-22; it landed on Second Wind, which went south).
The rampart's junction north onto Hallowed Hammer.
Strength once between the rampart junction and the resist star.
The far end of the road.
Hallowed Hammer's middle small west onto the totem chain, near a right angle to the mace chain: the totems are reached through a mace small, not through the mace notable.

Graven Posts on west to Stagger's first small, in the chain's own line: the totems are a bridge, not a dead end, and the tower's top meets Hallowed Hammer without the rampart's junction. Stagger stays 14 steps from the Vanguard start.
The cold spoke lands on Scar Tissue.
The lightning spoke lands on the crossing junction.
Junction to the maximum-resistance room: its second door.

Maces and sceptres (a near crossing; G1-brief.md §2.3, laid in the G2 border pass): Hallowed Hammer's far small onto the Cathedral's Vestry road, in the chain's own line. The sceptre fighter reaches Hallowed Hammer's elemental attacks; the mace player reaches the Vestry road and Gilded Rod. Hallowed Hammer stops being a dead-end pocket. It is 6 steps from the Zealot's armoured sceptre cluster (G3), which lands on the Battlements junction instead.

name: The Quarry
why: The Wall's south-west: the two-handed slam, armour by the slam road, the full-life diamond, pace, leech and regeneration, area damage, the totems and Strongarm, with the Quarry floor road across the middle. Every cluster here has two doors.

clusters.name: Thunderstep
clusters.why: Melee area first, then the notable with two-handed damage, melee area and radius: the two-handed slam, three steps below the south hub. Passed through to the junction; the pace chain leaves from its radius node.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the slam road.
The pace chain leaves here, and the Yard's crit pocket arrives.
The exit to the junction.

clusters.name: Bracing
clusters.why: Block with a shield twice, then the notable with block, block recovery and stun threshold: the Wall's shield, on the slam road at the Yard border (round 3, 2026-10-20; it was a step from the Bulwark wheel and the maces). The shield Vanguard leaves the start south-east, toward the Yard's Steel Rim and Buckler, and the mace player west; a step from Thunderstep, so the shield and the two-hander are neighbours that compete. Passed through to the slam wheel's east small and the Yard's flask pocket, but a build bound for the Yard can go round by Thunderstep's smalls (thunderstep.a, thunderstep.b) without buying it.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the slam road.

nodes.name: Bracing
nodes.why: 2.5 + 1 + 1 units: the shield that does not buckle. Its smalls are one unit each, 2% (3% until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22).
The exit, to the slam wheel and the Yard.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The fork between stun and the totems.

clusters.name: Unhurried
clusters.why: Movement speed, then a notable with movement and cooldown recovery (the guard skills' cooldown): a chain from the slams' radius node to the totems, a second way between them that skips the junction. The Vanguard is the slow class; this is where it buys pace.

nodes.name: Unhurried
nodes.why: Pace and footing: 2 + 1 units.

clusters.name: Unbloodied
clusters.why: Damage on full life three times round the notable with damage and crit on full life and life on kill: the Vanguard whose armour means the first hit never lands, the Wall's conditional damage. Its own diamond off the slam junction, passed through toward the warcries; the leech chain leaves from its notable. The crit mace is far off in the tower (Crushing Blow).

nodes.why: The entrance, from the junction.

nodes.name: Unbloodied
nodes.why: 2 + 1 + 1 units.
The exit, to the warcries.

clusters.name: Vampiric Strikes
clusters.why: Melee life leech, then the notable with leech, life on hit and mana leech: the melee attacker's recovery, which no other Wall node sells, as a chain from the stun notable to the far side of the warcries. A second way from the slams into the grit.

clusters.name: Ground Shaker
clusters.why: Area damage twice (any area, not only melee: the slam and the spell alike), then the notable with area damage, knockback and melee range: the big swing that moves the pack. A chain from the two-hander wheel's damage notable down to the leech chain's notable, across the empty quarter between the tower and the grit, so the tower and the slams are joined a second time, far out.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the road down from the tower junction.

nodes.name: Ground Shaker
nodes.why: 1 + 2 + 2 units: knockback and reach are lines no small node gives.
The exit, to Vampiric Strikes.

clusters.name: Standing Cairns
clusters.why: Totems: damage, speed (a totem skill's speed is both how fast it is placed and how fast it fires), duration. Reached from the junction and from the pace chain.

nodes.why: The entrance, top.

nodes.name: Standing Cairns
nodes.why: The slamming totem: damage and area, 2 + 1 units.
The exit, to the tip junction.
The west side.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The fork between the Strongarm spur and the near crossing to the Yard's swords and axes.

clusters.name: Strongarm
clusters.why: Two nodes of projectile attack damage, then the trade: strength's melee bonus applies to projectile attacks, dexterity gives no evasion. For the bow-totem Vanguard and the thrower.

clusters.name: Second Wind
clusters.why: Regeneration twice, then the notable with regeneration and life: the recovery decision, south of Unbloodied between the Quarry and the Barrows (G2, 2026-10-22; it was in the Rampart, a step off the home's road). With Vampiric Strikes and the Yard's Thirsting Blade beside it, regeneration or leech is a fork: one of them is enough for most builds.

nodes.why: The entrance, from Unbloodied.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.why: 2.5 units of regeneration and a little life: 4.1 units. The Barrows' middle road leaves south-west, the road to the Yard east.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength and dexterity once east of Second Wind, where the near crossing to the Yard's Thirsting Blade lands (G2, 2026-10-22).

clusters.name: The Quarry floor
clusters.why: Strength across the empty Quarry floor, from the slam junction west toward Ground Shaker (G2, 2026-10-22): a third way between the Quarry and the Barbican. Sledge and Sinew (mace with life) joins the two nodes since G3 round 2.

clusters.name: Sledge and Sinew
clusters.why: Mace damage three times on the Quarry floor, with the notable of mace damage and life in a triangle off the road: the slammer's mace with the body to swing it (G3 round 2, 2026-10-22; the ledger's VA-5). The smalls lie on the straight line between the floor's two road nodes, so the road is whole; the notable is a step north of it. South of the Gate by the slam road, where Weight of Iron (the stun) is west by the tower road: two plain maces, two directions, two partners. A mace build passing through takes the smalls; anyone else crossing the floor pays them as road.

nodes.why: The east end, from the slam junction side.

nodes.name: Sledge and Sinew
nodes.why: 2 + 1.6 units: 3.6. Mace damage with life, a weapon with a defence (the ledger's good kind of pair). The triangle's apex, north of the road.
The west end, toward Ground Shaker.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between the slam junction and the totems.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength and dexterity once on the near crossing to the Yard's Guarded.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Strength once between Vampiric Strikes and Ground Shaker.

links.why: Through the slams to the junction.
The slam road's second node onto the block pocket.
The slam wheel's east small onto the block pocket's far side.
The slams' radius node onto the pace chain.
Junction to the full-life diamond.
The full-life diamond's tip onto Second Wind: a third way into Unbloodied.
Second Wind east, toward the Yard's leech.

Regeneration or leech (a near crossing; G1-brief.md §2.4, laid in the G2 border pass): Second Wind through one node onto Thirsting Blade, in one straight line. One of the two is enough for most builds, so they sit a fork apart, and the route from the Quarry to the Pits passes through one or the other, not both. Thirsting Blade stops being a dead end, and the leech is 15 steps from the Vanguard start by this road (it was 19).
The slam junction onto the Quarry floor, west.
Ground Shaker onto the Quarry floor, east.
The Quarry floor west onto the mace smalls.
And on west to the floor road: the floor is whole, the slam junction to Ground Shaker.
Strength once between the slam junction and the totems.
The far end of the road.
Strength three times: the road from the Barrows north to Vampiric Strikes, with the strength caster's pocket off its middle.
The far end of the road.
Through the totems to the tip junction.
The diamond's second node onto the leech chain too: two doors.
Junction to the keystone spur.
Strength once between Vampiric Strikes and Ground Shaker.
The far end of the road.
